_about: Salt cell specs checked against manufacturer documents (2026-11). Same format as filters-2026-11.json; see README.md. Output is lb of chlorine per 24 h at 100%.

pentair-ic-30.note: Pentair's IntelliChlor guide lists IC15/IC20/IC40/IC60 only; no IC30 found. Possibly confused with the iChlor 30 (1.0 lb/day, 30k gal), which is a separate record. Check whether this record should be removed.

jandy-aquapure-700.note: Jandy manual: 283 g (0.625 lb) per 24 h, residential pools up to 12,000 gal; resolves the earlier source conflict

jandy-aquapure-1400.note: 567 g (1.25 lb) per 24 h, up to 40,000 gal

jandy-truclear-ei.note: Jandy: up to 0.93 lb/day, pools up to 35,000 gal (catalog had 0.92); resolves the earlier source conflict

autopilot-chlorsync-cs30.note: brochure: up to 30,000 gal, 1.1 lb/day at 3,500 ppm salt (rated gallons added)

autopilot-digital-nanoplus.note: Digital Nano+ (DNP2): 1.06 lb/day (20 g/h), pools up to 28,000 gal (rated gallons added)

autopilot-ppc5.note: up to 2.62 lb/day (49.5 g/h); manifold rated 80,000 gal

autopilot-digital-ppc1.note: a Pool Pilot manual table lists PPC1 at ~0.8 lb/day (15.1 g/h); catalog has 1.28 lb/day. The scan is garbled, so the catalog value is kept pending a clean source.

circupool-rj30p.note: CircuPool advertises 1.5 lb/day; TFP member testing measured ~71% of advertised on an RJ-45+. Already flagged advertised-output-disputed; catalog keeps the advertised value per SWG_OUTPUT_HAIRCUT.

circupool-rj45p.note: advertised 2.0 lb/day; member test ~71% of advertised. Kept, flagged.
